notes: Random slots (empty or holding a record), ports (0..3, out of range, random upper EDX bits), rates, durations and verbose flag. 0x10703c, 0x117e0c, 0x118694, 0x1186cc and 0x118664 log their registers and keep EBX/ECX/EDX; 0xcd12e logs its format and, for the search message, the COM number. 0xe8733, 0x117f68 and 0x106d34 return per-case values (allocation failure, open results 0, -1, -2 and others, random poll answers); 0x117f68 logs its four registers and its stack argument, pops it and clobbers EBX/ECX/EDX.
